name: chowa
description: LLM coding harness — tool-call normalization, workflow enforcement, and model routing across providers

scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=plugins/chowa/dist/cli.js && bun build src/integrations/claude-code/hooks/sessionStart.ts --target=node --outfile=plugins/chowa/dist/hooks/sessionStart.js && bun build src/integrations/claude-code/hooks/stopFailure.ts --target=node --outfile=plugins/chowa/dist/hooks/stopFailure.js
scripts.verify: bun test && bun run check:imports && bun run build && bun run lint
